findings.description: Baseline candidate is not human-confirmed; domains, KPI, owners and regulatory interpretations remain pending validation.
Scheduler and production batch inventory are inferred from repository evidence but not confirmed from runtime configuration.
API, report and document contracts are reconstructed from static evidence and require characterization tests before refactor.
Semantic reverse engineering was generated for tables and fields, but the meanings remain candidate inferences pending business validation.
A second semantic pass now cross-links flows, table usage, field usage, rules and evidence; these cross-evidence inferences still require characterization tests before canonical approval.
